blocks.body:
## The defensible headline is a better forgetting–utility frontier, not one universal score

Use each benchmark's native evaluator and compare every method under the same model, visible data, split, tuning budget, and seed policy. The current ZsRE `Eff/Gen/Spe` implementation is semantically aligned with ZeroUnlearn, but the stored aggregate is provisional because the exact execution commit and per-seed outputs are missing and PPL does not reproduce the public Base value.

## ZsRE task metrics are close enough to justify a parity rerun

Local versus public Base differs by only **+0.2696 pp Eff**, **−0.0321 pp Gen**, and **+0.0010 pp Spe**. PPL differs by **−1.8175**, which is material and proves that the fluency fixture or runtime identity is not yet shared. Focused evaluator tests pass **24/24**, but tests cannot reconstruct absent GPU artifacts.

## `FS/GFS` and `Eff/Gen` must remain separate

The target-true-sensitive MCF evaluator defines the original answer as sensitive and rewards `NLL(true) > NLL(new)`. ZeroUnlearn's MCF protocol evaluates persistence of the dataset's unwanted `target_new` and uses lower `Eff/Gen` as better. These are different targets, formulas, and directions. Run a main MCF-ZU comparison with native `Eff/Gen/Spe/PPL`, and retain MCF-Original `FS/GFS` as a separately named stress test.

## Scope, data, and definitions

Use a common ontology—efficacy, generalization/robustness, locality/retention, general utility, privacy, and efficiency—while preserving native metric names. Never average raw values across benchmarks. A secondary summary may report win/tie/loss, average rank, Pareto-front membership, or constrained forgetting among checkpoints that pass predeclared utility gates.

## The shared SURE core is portable through explicit adapters

Keep the frozen Base identity, contextual low-rank sparse edit, bounded forgetting objective, exact external-utility guard, checkpoint-dtype materialization, residual Stage 2, and one-way evaluation firewall. Define `SURE-F` and `SURE-U100K` so the pinned 100k-document cache is the only intentional difference. Fact QA is a direct fit; entity, passage, and hazardous-domain removal require named adapters or extensions.

## Limitations and robustness

Head-only success can be decoder suppression rather than representation erasure, especially on RWKU, MUSE, and WMDP. Report frozen-head, adversarial, MIA, relearning, free-generation, and collapse diagnostics after checkpoint freeze. The local audit validates semantics and completeness only; it cannot certify missing historical outputs.

## Execute foundation work before expensive scaling

First freeze metric and baseline contracts, then reproduce ZsRE and the factual suite, then complete RWKU/TOFU, and only then build passage/domain extensions for MUSE and WMDP. Every main-table row needs immutable sources, complete per-run artifacts, confidence intervals, raw counts, compute accounting, and proof that held-out data never selected the checkpoint.

## Further questions

- What does `SURE-F` expand to?
- Does `MQuAKE-R` mean MQuAKE-Remastered or the current ZeroUnlearn-style track?
- Will the paper use benchmark-native models or one common Llama family where possible?
- What tuning and final-run compute budget can be precommitted?

zsre_validity.evidence: Adapter mirrors upstream token decisions and per-record macro averaging; 24 focused tests pass.
zsre_validity.required_action: Preserve evaluator parity tests in CI.

zsre_validity.evidence: Seeds 1–10 and 50/1000 half-split policy match; exact dataset/model hashes are not attached to the aggregate.
zsre_validity.required_action: Rerun with source, model, tokenizer, split, and token hashes.

zsre_validity.evidence: Aggregate is terminal-captured; exact execution commit and referenced output roots are absent.
zsre_validity.required_action: Regenerate all per-seed results and receipts.

zsre_validity.evidence: Local Base PPL is 11.0625; public ZeroUnlearn Base PPL is 12.88.
zsre_validity.required_action: Lock one fixture and reproduce identical Base token IDs and PPL.

zsre_validity.evidence: Metric semantics are credible, but result reconstruction is impossible from current artifacts.
zsre_validity.required_action: Do not cite as final until the parity rerun passes.

metric_contract.warning: Separate task; never compare raw FS/GFS to ZeroUnlearn Eff/Gen
Do not interpret a KS p-value alone
Resolve MQuAKE-R identity; extensions are not native ZeroUnlearn columns
Below-chance row suppression is not automatically stronger unlearning

architecture_fit.required_change: Instance-first multi-row adapter and held-out atomic/multi-hop evaluation
Target-only atomic corpus, wider sensitive rows, native attack/MIA/locality suite
Author/profile multi-token adapter and native Full/retain models
Passage/span objective, privacy firewall, sequential requests
Hazardous-corpus sequence objective; likely contextual internal-layer edit

phase_plan.objective: Freeze SURE variants, metric schema, MCF semantics, baseline provenance, and MQuAKE identity.
Reproduce ZsRE and run MCF/MQuAKE under common evaluators.
phase_plan.exit_gate: Base and strong baseline parity; complete 10-seed receipts.

phase_plan.objective: Complete RWKU official evaluation and TOFU native suite.
phase_plan.exit_gate: Native utility, robustness, and privacy gates pass.

phase_plan.objective: Implement MUSE and WMDP extensions with head-only ablations.
phase_plan.exit_gate: End-to-end native evaluator plus strong maintained baselines.

phase_plan.objective: Freeze, run final seeds/targets, aggregate statistics, and release artifacts.
phase_plan.exit_gate: Every table row is reproducible from immutable receipts.
